brief:
Izz ad-Din al-Qassam Brigades, the military wing of Hamas, released video footage on its "Tufan Aqmar" channel documenting battles fought by slain fighter Anas al-Dreimly against Israeli occupation forces, Shehab Wire reported. The material shows destruction of military vehicles and close-range combat engagements during clashes with Israeli troops.

The brigades released the footage as part of ongoing documentation of armed operations conducted during the conflict. The video captures scenes from what the organization described as fierce battles in which al-Dreimly participated before his death. The release comes as part of a pattern of the military wing publishing operational records through its media channels.
